D: Three friends wake up in a trashed Las Vegas suite with no memory of the night and no sign of the groom.
P: Serve the drinks when the boys toast on the hotel roof.
S: Poached prawns on ice with tomato horseradish cocktail sauce

Prawns poached 2 minutes, iced, piled high on crushed ice with cocktail sauce of tomato sauce, horseradish and lemon. Poach 600g green prawns in salted water for 2 minutes, plunge into iced water and peel, leaving the tails on. Mix 125ml tomato sauce with 1 tbsp horseradish and lemon juice. Pile the prawns on a bag of crushed ice with the sauce and lemon wedges.
Crisp grated potato cakes topped with a fried egg
Grated potato squeezed dry, seasoned, pressed into thin cakes, fried in butter and oil until deep golden, a fried egg on top.
the chicken wandering around the suite

Buttermilk-brined chicken breast chunks rolled in crushed cornflakes and seasoned flour, fried crunchy and golden, with a honey mustard dip. Cut 600g chicken breast into chunks and soak in 250ml buttermilk with salt for 1 hour. Crush 100g cornflakes and mix with 50g plain flour, 1 tsp paprika and 1 tsp garlic powder. Coat the chicken and fry at 175C for 4 minutes until golden and cooked through. Mix 3 tbsp honey, 3 tbsp Dijon and 2 tbsp mayo for dipping.
M: a big night on the Strip

Dry-brined rib eye seared hard and rested, with a buttery tarragon béarnaise, creamed spinach and a loaded baked potato. Salt 4 rib eyes and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Bake 4 potatoes at 200C for 1 hour. Reduce 3 tbsp white wine vinegar with a chopped shallot and tarragon to 1 tbsp, whisk with 3 yolks over simmering water, then slowly whisk in 180g melted butter. Sear the steaks to 54C inside and rest. Wilt 400g spinach with garlic and 100ml cream. Load the potatoes with sour cream, bacon and chives.
Scrambled eggs, crisp potato, chorizo and cheddar in flour tortillas, fresh salsa

Flour tortillas filled with soft scrambled eggs, chorizo, potato, cheddar and salsa, rolled, toasted in a dry pan. Dice and fry 300g potatoes until crisp, then add 200g diced chorizo. Softly scramble 8 eggs. Fill 4 large flour tortillas with the eggs, potato, chorizo, 100g cheddar and a fresh salsa of 2 tomatoes and onion. Roll and toast in a dry pan.
W: Lemon sponge layers filled with lemon curd and covered in buttercream
Lemon butter cake baked at 170C, split and filled with lemon curd and vanilla buttercream, covered smooth and chilled before slicing.
K: Herbal liqueur and lime topped with ginger beer, served over ice with orange

Ice-cold herbal liqueur with fresh lime and spicy ginger beer, poured over ice in tall glasses with an orange slice. Put the herbal liqueur in the freezer for an hour. Fill four tall glasses with ice. Add 30ml liqueur and the juice of half a lime to each, then top with 150ml cold ginger beer. Stir once, add an orange slice and toast on the roof.
